# Atelier

> Multi-agent research framework that automates literature reviews, citation generation, research gap analysis, methodology recommendation, and report compilation from uploaded PDFs.

Atelier coordinates five specialised AI agents — Literature Review, Citation, Research Gap, Methodology, and Report Generator — that hand outputs to each other to produce a publishable research manuscript.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the multi-agent framework and how the five agents collaborate.
- [Sign in](/auth): Sign in or create an Atelier account.
